answers.how: Measured the ball diameter as approximately 35.5 px and fitted its horizontal position versus time near 1 s. Speed ≈176 px/s × (0.21 m / 35.5 px).
The curvature of the fitted position-time trajectory near 1 s gives approximately 122 px/s². Converted using 0.21 m / 35.5 px.
The fitted horizontal trajectory gives approximately 259 px/s at 2 s. Converted using the ball's scale of 0.21 m / 35.5 px.
The curvature of the fitted position-time trajectory near 2 s gives approximately 54 px/s². Converted using 0.21 m / 35.5 px.
